share.heading: Silverleaf lesson plans
share.intro: Read any lesson plan and download its slides. Use your Silverleaf email to open this page. You can only look and download — nothing here can be changed.

gone.heading: This link is not working
gone.body: The link may have been turned off or copied wrongly. Ask the school office for a new link.

slides.heading: Slides
slides.ready: The slides for this lesson are ready.
slides.notReady: Slides for this lesson have not been made yet. Create them (takes about a minute), or download simple slides now.
slides.wait: Please wait about a minute. Do not close this page.

error.too-many: Too many slides were made just now. Please try again later, or download the simple slides.
error.no-api-key: Making new slides is not available now. Download the simple slides instead.
error.no-credits: Making new slides is not available now. Download the simple slides instead.
error.rate-limit: The slide maker is busy. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.model-error: The slides could not be made. Please try again, or download the simple slides.
error.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

admin.heading: Teacher share links
admin.intro: A share link lets anyone with a Silverleaf Academy email address (teachers and instructional leaders) read the lesson plans and download slides. They cannot change anything. Anyone with the link can try it, but must give a @silverleaf.co.tz address. Turn a link off if it reaches the wrong people.
admin.confirmRevoke: Turn this link off? Teachers using it will lose access.

error.invalid-input: Write who the link is for.
error.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

access.heading: Sign in with your school email
access.body: This link is for Silverleaf Academy staff. Enter your Silverleaf email address (name@silverleaf.co.tz) to open it.

error.not-school-email: Please use your Silverleaf Academy email address (ending @silverleaf.co.tz).
error.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.invalid-code: That code is not correct or has expired. Check your email, or ask for a new code.
error.too-soon: A code was just sent. Please wait a minute before asking for another.
error.too-many: Too many codes were requested. Please try again later.
error.send-failed: We could not send the code. Please try again.

access.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it to open the link. It works once and expires in 10 minutes.
